main.summary: Defines the stable kind values used by .

field.name: StagedObject
field.summary: Identifies the staged serialized object payload.

field.name: PublicationObjectRecoveryCopy
field.summary: Identifies the publication object's staging recovery copy.

field.name: FinalObjectCandidate
field.summary: Identifies the candidate final object artifact; its existence is not verified.

field.name: FinalStreamCandidate
field.summary: Identifies the candidate final stream artifact; its existence is not verified.

field.name: FinalIntegrityCandidate
field.summary: Identifies the candidate final integrity artifact; its existence is not verified.

main.summary: Identifies a transfer session whose publication recovery footprint is requested.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the transfer session identifier to inspect.

main.summary: Describes the recorded recovery state and artifact candidates for one transfer session.
main.remarks: This is a database snapshot, not verification that any external Blob or catalog record exists. It contains no payload bytes or storage credentials.

property.name: InspectedAt
property.summary: Gets the UTC time at which the database snapshot was read.

property.name: ExternalArtifactExistenceChecked
property.summary: Gets whether external artifact existence was checked; inspection currently always returns false.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the transfer session identifier.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the item identifier associated with the transfer.

property.name: CatalogName
property.summary: Gets the owning catalog name.

property.name: Family
property.summary: Gets the transfer family.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: Gets the transfer mode.

property.name: Status
property.summary: Gets the recorded transfer status.

property.name: SessionStateVersion
property.summary: Gets the session state version used as a purge freshness condition.

property.name: SessionUpdated
property.summary: Gets the session update timestamp.

property.name: OperationID
property.summary: Gets the publication operation identifier, when a journal exists.

property.name: Phase
property.summary: Gets the publication journal phase, when a journal exists.

property.name: JournalUpdated
property.summary: Gets the journal update timestamp used as a purge freshness condition.

property.name: FailureCount
property.summary: Gets the number of recorded publication failures.

property.name: LastError
property.summary: Gets the sanitized recorded publication error, when available.

property.name: ExpectedStateVersion
property.summary: Gets the state version expected by the publication journal.

property.name: ExpectedObjectLength
property.summary: Gets the recorded expected serialized object length.

property.name: ExpectedObjectSHA512
property.summary: Gets the recorded expected serialized object SHA-512 digest.

property.name: ExpectedStreamLength
property.summary: Gets the recorded expected stream length, when applicable.

property.name: ExpectedStreamIntegrity
property.summary: Gets the recorded stream integrity evidence, when applicable.

property.name: StagingArtifacts
property.summary: Gets staging Blob references recorded by the session and journal.

property.name: StagingPrefix
property.summary: Gets the session-specific staging Blob prefix.

property.name: FinalArtifacts
property.summary: Gets candidate final artifact names and any recorded metadata; these artifacts remain under operator control.

property.name: IntegrityEvidence
property.summary: Gets the recorded stream integrity evidence, when available.

main.summary: Describes an artifact candidate or recorded Blob reference in a recovery footprint.
main.remarks: A final artifact candidate name is not evidence that the Blob exists. Length and SHA-512 are present only when recorded for the Blob itself.

property.name: Kind
property.summary: Gets the artifact category.

property.name: BlobName
property.summary: Gets the Blob name within the item container.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the recorded artifact length, when available.

property.name: SHA512
property.summary: Gets the recorded artifact SHA-512 digest, when available.

property.name: OperationID
property.summary: Gets the associated stream-chunk operation identifier, when applicable.

property.name: Offset
property.summary: Gets the range or chunk offset, when applicable.

main.summary: Requests deletion of one transfer session's staging Blobs and DataControl database state.
main.remarks: Final artifact Blobs and catalog data are never deleted by this operation. Explicit confirmation is required.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the transfer session identifier.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the item identifier expected to own the session.

property.name: CatalogName
property.summary: Gets the catalog expected to own the session.

property.name: ExpectedSessionStateVersion
property.summary: Gets the session state version returned by inspection.

property.name: ExpectedOperationID
property.summary: Gets the journal operation identifier returned by inspection, or null when no journal existed.

property.name: ExpectedPhase
property.summary: Gets the journal phase returned by inspection, or null when no journal existed.

property.name: ExpectedJournalUpdated
property.summary: Gets the journal update timestamp returned by inspection, or null when no journal existed.

property.name: ConfirmPurge
property.summary: Gets the required explicit confirmation to purge session state and staging Blobs.

main.summary: Reports the DataControl cleanup performed for a transfer session.
main.remarks: Final artifact candidates and catalog data are left untouched; candidate names do not establish external existence.

property.name: Purged
property.summary: Gets whether the purge completed.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the purged transfer session identifier.

property.name: OperationID
property.summary: Gets the publication operation identifier, when one was journaled.

property.name: StagingArtifactsDeleted
property.summary: Gets whether the session staging prefix was deleted.

property.name: DatabaseStateDeleted
property.summary: Gets whether the journal, session, and dependent transfer metadata were deleted.

property.name: FinalArtifactsDeleted
property.summary: Gets whether final published artifacts were deleted; this operation always returns false.

property.name: CatalogDataDeleted
property.summary: Gets whether catalog data was deleted; this operation always returns false.

property.name: FinalArtifactCandidatesLeftUntouched
property.summary: Gets candidate final artifact names left untouched by purge.

property.name: Message
property.summary: Gets a summary of the cleanup boundary.
